description: Intent i002 (rx-pull-stale-hdr, snapshot s01) complete. Method: same-function capture->pull->stale-deref static scan ($TMPDIR/i002/scan2.py) over 140 net/ files containing pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/__pskb_pull_tail/skb_linearize produced 43 raw chains; top candidates deep-read with exact source lines. FINDINGS (4): (1) HIGH s01:net/mac80211/rx.c:3167-3181 — ieee80211_rx_h_data TDLS block: struct ieee80211_tdls_data *tf = (void *)rx->skb->data captured at 3169 from a remote attacker-supplied ETH_P_TDLS 802.3-converted frame; pskb_may_pull(rx->skb, offsetof(struct ieee80211_tdls_data, u)) at 3171-3172 is the left operand of && and may __pskb_pull_tail/pskb_expand_head-free the head for a non-linear RX skb; stale tf->payload_type/tf->category/tf->action_code reads at 3173-3176 with no refetch gate queuing via __ieee80211_queue_skb_to_iface at 3178 — exact pep_get_sb() shape. (2) MEDIUM s01:net/mac80211/rx.c:4802-4894 — ieee80211_invoke_fast_rx: hdr captured from skb->data at 4803, never reassigned; pskb_may_pull(skb, snap_offs + sizeof(*payload)) at 4869 (and pskb_trim at 4881) may reallocate head; hdr->frame_control read at 4893 post-pull (contrast payload correctly captured after the pull at 4872). (3) LOW s01:net/ipv6/ip6_output.c:410-454 — ip6_forward_proxy_check: hdr = ipv6_hdr(skb) at 411; pskb_may_pull at 426-427 in the ICMPV6 branch; ipv6_addr_type(&hdr->daddr) at 453 through possibly stale hdr. (4) LOW s01:net/ipv4/udp_offload.c:24-46 — __skb_udp_tunnel_segment: uh = udp_hdr(skb) at 25; pskb_may_pull(skb, tnl_hlen) at 33; stale uh->len/uh->check reads at 43/46. Seed pep_get_sb() itself is present unpatched in s01 (net/phonet/pep.c:55-59) and recorded as baseline. Classified SAFE with concrete evidence: espintcp.c (rxm is skb->cb), act_skbedit.c (action data), wpa.c (hdr refetched after linearize at 157/284; CCMP/GCMP pull before capture), exthdrs.c + esp4/esp6_offload + mac80211 RXCB (IP6CB/xfrm_offload/IEEE80211_SKB_RXCB are skb->cb pointers unaffected by head realloc), tcp_ipv4/6 (dev_net per-netns), tipc msg_reverse (capture after linearize), tcp_offload (sk_buff metadata), udp.c/icmp.c (skb_rtable dst). LIMITATIONS: all findings are static hypotheses — the reallocation precondition (non-linear/cloned skb at the specific pull) was not dynamically reproduced with KASAN; the scanner only catches same-function 'type *var = expr' captures (no interprocedural/outer-loop analysis); drivers/ RX paths, headers, arch/ and fs/ were not scanned; loop-parser (i004) and GRO/frag-list (i005) shapes are covered by parallel intents; the udp_offload candidate is on a segmentation path and has the weakest precondition.
